description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Manufacturer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Producer" name="Airplane producer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SpecificationsReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BarChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BarMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureVodkaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureBarOption3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureBarOption4</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureBarOption5</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOtherParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" name="Manufacture required parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoice" name="Selected bar option"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Russian team manufactures vodka bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Irish team manufactures whiskey bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" name="Manufacture selected bar option 3"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption4" name="Manufacture selected bar option 4"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption5" name="Manufacture selected bar option 5"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarMerge" name="Bar manufacturing complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" name="Manufacture other specified interior parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" name="All required parts manufactured"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual manufactured parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Test flight and protocol work"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct airplane test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer and producer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_1" sourceRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_5" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Vodka bar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>selectedBar = 'vodka'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_6" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Whiskey bar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>selectedBar = 'whiskey'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_7" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" name="Bar option 3">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>selectedBar = 'option 3'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_8" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption4" name="Bar option 4">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>selectedBar = 'option 4'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_9" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption5" name="Bar option 5">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>selectedBar = 'option 5'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_10" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_11" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_12" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_13" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption4" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_14" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption5" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_15" sourceRef="Gateway_BarMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_16" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_18" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_19" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_20" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_21" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_22" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_23" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_24" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_25" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_26" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_27" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Configure and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin airplane configuration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose one of five bars and specify seats, color, and toilet water amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to producer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive airplane"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
